column1: # Turkish (tr) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    usually empty. `preview` words sample text inside rendered previews (the Design
#              tab's style-set tiles), which must fit a small tile; it falls back to the plain entry.
#   source     exact English lookup key (tl!(...), ribbon and command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\ inside a column. Keep all `{name}` placeholders and trailing ….
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. Missing entries show in English.
# Clean room: written from the meaning of the English labels in ordinary Turkish computing
# vocabulary. No Microsoft Word or other proprietary product's translated UI or string table
# was consulted or copied. Product/format names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP ...) stay intact.
# Commands use imperatives; labels use natural Turkish. After a count the noun stays singular
# (1 sözcük, 2 sözcük). This catalog format has no plural contexts or separate one/other forms.
